notes: Curated SMALL set. Licenses verified at time of writing. Always re-check a repo's LICENSE file before copying assets.

fonts.name: Amiri
fonts.style: Classical Naskh, calligraphic book face (Bulaq Press revival)
fonts.webUse: Google Fonts CDN or self-host; variable + static available upstream

fonts.name: Aref Ruqaa
fonts.webUse: Google Fonts CDN or self-host (also ships Ink color-font variant upstream)

fonts.name: Reem Kufi
fonts.style: Modern geometric Kufi display, Fatimid-grid based — wordmark-oriented
fonts.webUse: Google Fonts CDN (variable wght 100-900) or self-host

fonts.name: Lalezar
fonts.style: Heavy poster display with Arabic coverage

ornaments.name: arabic-honorific-ligatures
ornaments.type: 61 handcrafted Arabic/Islamic honorific ligature SVGs (union paths) + PNGs + specimen
ornaments.attribution: Credit 'BaAlwi Heritage (ID)' where the asset is used/redistributed
ornaments.fetch: on-demand per glyph (do NOT vendor all 61; copy only the glyphs actually used)

ornaments.name: arabicart-patterns (Bourgoin)
ornaments.type: Ornamental patterns from the digital edition of Jules Bourgoin's 'The Elements of Arabic Art'
ornaments.license: VERIFY in repo before use (artwork 1873 public domain; digital edition terms may apply)

ornaments.name: ArabicCalligraphy (atmorojo)
ornaments.type: Ready-made Arabic calligraphy SVG compositions (e.g. Ramadan themes)
useFor: seasonal/occasion artwork when the phrase matches exactly

ornaments.name: iconify (configured MCP)
ornaments.type: 200k+ icons incl. geometric/star ornaments via the already-configured iconify MCP
ornaments.license: per icon set (check get_icon_set; prefer CC0/MIT/Apache sets)

manualTools.name: Kaleam
manualTools.purpose: Professional Arabic calligraphy typesetting (Thuluth, Diwani, Naskh, Persian, Ruqah) with full curve/stretch control; exports SVG/PDF
manualTools.integration: MANUAL ONLY — no public API, no MCP. Designer works in browser, exports SVG, agent integrates the file.
manualTools.cost: Subscription (check current pricing); corporate plans via info@kaleam.com
useFor: any artwork where local fonts are insufficient

manualTools.name: arabiccalligraphy.app
manualTools.purpose: Free browser calligraphy generator, 12 OFL fonts, HarfBuzz-correct shaping, PNG/SVG/PDF export, no account
manualTools.integration: MANUAL ONLY — browser tool, no API. Quick compositions without a Kaleam subscription.

manualTools.name: kashida.fyi
manualTools.purpose: Interactive kashida placement preview (same Hosny algorithm as vendored kashida.js) + Sukoon variable-font KSHD axis demo
manualTools.integration: MANUAL visual check; agent uses kashida-text.mjs for deterministic output

localTools.name: shape-text.mjs
localTools.output: self-contained SVG (glyph outlines, no font dependency)

localTools.name: kashida-text.mjs
localTools.output: Unicode text with principled tatweel placement

localTools.name: lint-arabic.mjs
localTools.output: human or JSON findings; exit 1 on errors

localTools.name: naqsh (npm dep)
localTools.output: self-contained SVG avatars/monograms from roots or letter strategies
localTools.caveat: review build, not an SDK; use rootStrategy 'letters' or explicit root for predictable output
